messages:
maya: heads-up: proposing small, opt-in SDK change — emit a compact `X-Redwood-Policy` header (json-lite) for improved quota mapping. keeps backwards compat with routehint.
oliver: concrete change? will the header be computed client-side or returned from routing-service?
maya: clients compute it when they have tenant policy info; otherwise leave blank. SDKs provide helper builder so apps don't craft header manually.
sree: console needs a dry-run tile to simulate how requests would be bucketed under the new header. please include a "simulate on history" endpoint.
maya: rollout plan: 1) telemetry-only (emit presence events), 2) opt-in helper in SDKs, 3) console simulation, 4) warn-by-default + deprecate routehint. each stage ~2w.
oliver: PY gotcha — short-lived CLI processes may not send background handshake. provide sync helper `client.flush_policy()` for CLI use.
devex-bot: reminder: add changelog entry + migration note to quickstart.
maya: action items: oliver to draft py/ts helper APIs, sree to spec console dry-run, i'll write RFC and timeline.
